database.stem: John Clarke, who is in the prime of his career, has been ranked ------- the top 10 players in tennis history by Sports Daily.
database.raw_text:
John Clarke, who is in the prime of his career, has been ranked ------- the top
10 players in tennis history by Sports Daily.
(A) at
(B) into
(C) among
(D) from
database.explanation:
由备选答案可以看出，本题考查介词。谓语has been ranked
后用the top 10 players in tennis history(网球史上的十佳选手)限制了
具体范围，因此(C)among(在…之中)最恰当。
